record_type: implemented material and projected texel-density contract, not a calibrated screenshot measurement

shrine_emission.scope: Only one cloned ember material per shrine; shared body atlas and world-owned flames/lights remain separate.

masonry_uv0.quantization_rule: Apply loaded node world/normal matrices before projection. UV1 and all geometry/contact data stay unchanged.
masonry_uv0.caveat: Nominal texels per projected planar metre, not uniform measured density on every curved/sloped triangle. Historical density audits are not a post-change guarantee.

runtime_masonry_maps.high: 4K floor base color; 2K floor normal/ORM and all wall maps

atlas_props.note: UV-atlas assets are not governed by the 4 m tiling rule.

lighting_and_color_caveat: Palette values are material inputs; lightmaps, exposure, tone mapping and display transform determine final screen colors. Full lighting-calibration review is owned by the integrating task.
